evidence.note: The paper's count of KiTS'23 scans inside AbdomenAtlas 3.0; no case-level mapping is published.

explanation: AbdomenAtlas 3.0 reuses 489 KiTS'23 CT scans. Their patients are counted in both releases, so the counts must not be added. KiTS23 labels tumour and cyst separately. AbdomenAtlas 3.0 has a single kidney lesion mask per scan that does not say whether a lesion is a tumour or a cyst; whether KiTS23 cysts were kept in it is not documented.

evidence.locator: Table 1 (489 KiTS'23 scans); KiTS23 labels.py (separate tumor and cyst classes); mask_only listing (one kidney_lesion.nii.gz per case, no typed kidney files)
